title: Migration and Innovation: The Impact of East German Inventors on West Germany’s Technological Development
title_zh: 移民与创新：东德发明家对西德技术发展的影响
title_primary: 移民与创新：东德发明家对西德技术发展的影响
title_secondary: Migration and Innovation: The Impact of East German Inventors on West Germany’s Technological Development
authors: Antonin Bergeaud, Max Deter, Maria Greve, Michael Wyrwich
official: 官方在线 2025-01-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We investigate the causal relationship between inventor migration and regional innovation in the context of the large-scale migration shock from East to West Germany between World War II and the construction of the Berlin Wall in 1961. Leveraging a newly constructed, century-spanning dataset on German patents and inventors, along with an innovative identification strategy based on surname proximity, we trace the trajectories of East German inventors and quantify their impact on innovation in West Germany. Our findings demonstrate a significant and persistent boost to patenting activities in regions with higher inflows of East German inventors, predominantly driven by advancements in chemistry and physics. We further validate the robustness of our identification strategy against alternative plausible mechanisms. We show in particular that the effect is stronger than the one caused by the migration of other high skilled workers and scientists.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在二战至1961年柏林墙修建期间，东德向西德大规模迁移冲击背景下，发明家迁移与区域创新之间的因果关系。利用新构建的跨越百年的德国专利与发明家数据集，以及基于姓氏邻近性的创新识别策略，我们追踪了东德发明家的轨迹，并量化了他们对西德创新的影响。研究结果显示，东德发明家流入较多的地区，其专利申请活动得到了显著且持续的提升，这一提升主要由化学和物理学领域的进步所驱动。我们进一步验证了我们的识别策略相对于其他可能机制的稳健性。我们特别指出，这一效应强于其他高技能工人和科学家迁移所带来的影响。

title: Allocation of Foreign Aid in Emerging Economies: Investment in New vs Maintenance of Old Infrastructure
title_zh: 新兴经济体中的外国援助分配：新基础设施投资与旧基础设施维护
title_primary: 新兴经济体中的外国援助分配：新基础设施投资与旧基础设施维护
title_secondary: Allocation of Foreign Aid in Emerging Economies: Investment in New vs Maintenance of Old Infrastructure
authors: Rolando A. Escobar-Posada, Goncalo Monteiro, Stephen J. Turnovsky
official: 官方在线 2026-09-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper analyzes the growth and welfare effects of allocating public resources — both domestic tax revenues and foreign aid — between investment in new public capital and the maintenance of existing public capital in emerging economies. We show that moderate increases in maintenance enhance growth and welfare by improving capital efficiency and longevity, while excessive maintenance crowds out consumption and productive investment and has adverse effects. Foreign aid, by easing domestic fiscal constraints, enables lower distortionary taxation, but its effectiveness depends on both its composition and interaction with domestic fiscal policies. Our study emphasizes the importance of a balanced allocation. Numerical simulations suggest that for a plausible calibration an approximate 80-20 split allocation between new investment and maintenance is desirable, but it is sensitive to the quality of the public capital. For the calibrated benchmark model donor-imposed co-financing requirements have conflicting effects on growth and welfare, although these are highly sensitive to the productivity of public capital, but less so to the allocation.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了新兴经济体在公共资源配置——包括国内税收收入与外国援助——中，将资金用于新增公共资本投资与维护现有公共资本之间的增长与福利效应。研究表明，适度增加维护投入能通过提升资本效率与延长资本寿命来促进增长与福利，而过度的维护则会挤出消费与生产性投资，产生不利影响。外国援助通过缓解国内财政约束，能够降低扭曲性税收，但其效果取决于援助的构成及其与国内财政政策的相互作用。本研究强调了平衡配置的重要性。数值模拟显示，在合理的参数校准下，新增投资与维护之间约80-20的分配比例较为理想，但这一比例对公共资本的质量敏感。在基准模型校准中，捐助方强制的共同融资要求对增长与福利产生相互冲突的影响，尽管这些影响对公共资本的生产率高度敏感，但对分配比例的敏感度较低。

title: The Causal Effect of Parents' Education on Children's Earnings
title_zh: 父母教育对子女收入的因果效应
title_primary: 父母教育对子女收入的因果效应
title_secondary: The Causal Effect of Parents' Education on Children's Earnings
authors: Sang Yoon (Tim) Lee, Nicolas Roys, Ananth Seshadri
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We develop and estimate a model of endogenous schooling and earnings to isolate the causal effect of parents' education on children's outcomes. Identification uses earnings differences among children with equal schooling whose parents have different schooling. Health and Retirement Study data indicate that the observed intergenerational schooling correlation is largely driven by correlated unobserved preferences for schooling. This is partly offset by a slightly negative structural relationship between parents' and children's schooling choices. Nevertheless, an exogenous one‐year increase in parents' schooling raises children's lifetime earnings by 2 % on average.
abstract_zh: 我们构建并估计了一个关于内生教育与收入的经济模型，旨在分离父母教育对子女结果的因果效应。识别策略利用的是，在子女教育水平相同但父母教育背景不同的情况下，其收入差异。健康与退休研究数据显示，观察到的代际教育相关性主要由未观测到的教育偏好相关性驱动。这一效应部分被父母与子女教育选择之间略微负向的结构性关系所抵消。尽管如此，父母教育年限外生增加一年，平均可使子女终身收入提高2%。

title: Anatomy of a supervisory failure
title_zh: 监管失败的剖析
title_primary: 监管失败的剖析
title_secondary: Anatomy of a supervisory failure
authors: Eric S Rosengren, Niccolò Comati
official: 官方在线 2026-08-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: For its entire 15-year life as a regional bank until its collapse in 2023, Silicon Valley Bank held the same risky bet. This column argues that the risks were visible the whole time. The bank experienced rapid asset and stock price growth and maintained a high-risk profile with long-term securities funded by largely uninsured demand deposits. However, supervisors reacted only once unrecognised held-to-maturity losses materialised following the 2022-2023 interest rate increases. Thus, Silicon Valley Bank’s collapse is less a story of hidden danger than of a supervisory system that polices process rather than risk.
abstract_zh: 在其作为区域性银行长达15年的存续期内，直至2023年倒闭，硅谷银行始终持有同一高风险赌注。本文认为，这些风险自始至终显而易见。该银行经历了资产和股价的快速增长，并维持着高风险特征，以长期证券为主，资金主要来源于未投保的活期存款。然而，监管机构仅在2022-2023年利率上调后，未确认的持有至到期损失显现时才作出反应。因此，硅谷银行的倒闭与其说是隐藏风险的故事，不如说是监管体系侧重于过程监管而非风险监管的体现。

title: Productivity and inflation dynamics
title_zh: 生产率与通货膨胀动态
title_primary: 生产率与通货膨胀动态
title_secondary: Productivity and inflation dynamics
authors: Ludovica Ambrosino & Jenny Chan & Silvana Tenreyro
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How does higher productivity affect inflation? Productivity shifts both supply and demand (through real incomes), and its effect on inflation depends on their relative magnitude and timing, as well as on the monetary policy response. We distinguish between a one-off level shock that increases productivity temporarily (relative to trend) and a persistent rise in productivity growth. A one-off, temporary increase in productivity lowers marginal costs and raises potential output, generating downward pressure on the price level. Once prices adjust however, inflation returns to target. By contrast, higher productivity growth raises expected permanent income and stimulates investment and consumption, increasing the natural real rate. Absent a tightening of monetary policy, inflationary pressures may emerge. Anticipation effects are central: if demand rises ahead of realised supply gains, inflation can increase despite higher productive capacity. In an open economy, the sectoral incidence of the shock also determines the impact on inflation. In summary, the inflationary consequences of productivity gains are a priori ambiguous and depend on the balance and timing of demand and supply responses, the composition of demand, and crucially, the monetary policy response.
abstract_zh: 更高的生产率如何影响通货膨胀？生产率同时影响供给与需求（通过实际收入），其对通胀的影响取决于两者的相对规模与时机，以及货币政策的应对。我们区分了暂时性（相对于趋势）提高生产率的单次水平冲击与生产率增长的持续性上升。一次性、暂时性的生产率提升会降低边际成本并提高潜在产出，对价格水平产生下行压力。然而，一旦价格调整完毕，通胀将回归目标水平。相比之下，生产率增长的提高会提升预期永久收入，刺激投资与消费，从而提高自然实际利率。若货币政策不收紧，则可能出现通胀压力。预期效应至关重要：如果需求在实现供给收益之前上升，即使生产能力增强，通胀也可能上升。在开放经济中，冲击的行业分布也决定其对通胀的影响。总之，生产率提升的通胀后果在理论上是不确定的，取决于需求与供给反应的平衡与时机、需求结构，以及关键的政策应对。

title: Paying Not to Know: News Avoidance in Times of War
title_zh: 花钱不知：战争时期的新闻回避
title_primary: 花钱不知：战争时期的新闻回避
title_secondary: Paying Not to Know: News Avoidance in Times of War
authors: Ro'ee Levy, Moses Shayo, Guy Yanay
official: 官方在线 2026-08-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Do individuals at war avoid news about outgroup victims? Would such news affect them if they were exposed to it? We study Israelis and Jordanians during the 2023-2025 Gaza war. Four findings stand out. First, individuals are substantially less willing to read about outgroup than ingroup civilian victims. Second, news avoidance is driven less by instrumental considerations or universal affective factors, and more by social identity and group norms. Third, reading about outgroup victims increases knowledge, fosters empathy toward the outgroup, and affects policy positions. Finally, these effects arise even among individuals who would rather avoid such news.
abstract_zh: 战争中的个体会回避关于外群体受害者的新闻吗？如果接触到这类新闻，又会否对他们产生影响？我们以2023-2025年加沙战争期间的以色列人和约旦人为研究对象。研究得出四项主要发现。第一，个体阅读外群体平民受害者新闻的意愿显著低于阅读内群体受害者新闻。第二，新闻回避行为更多由社会身份和群体规范驱动，而非出于工具性考量或普遍的情感因素。第三，阅读关于外群体受害者的新闻能增进知识、培养对外群体的同理心，并影响政策立场。最后，这些效应即便在那些宁愿回避此类新闻的个体中也会显现。

title: Subjective Survival Expectations and Annuitisation Decisions
title_zh: 主观生存预期与年金化决策
title_primary: 主观生存预期与年金化决策
title_secondary: Subjective Survival Expectations and Annuitisation Decisions
authors: Tianyu Pang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper estimates a dynamic model of annuitisation in which individuals hold subjective survival beliefs that may differ from their actual mortality risk. I show that biased survival beliefs reduce annuitisation at retirement but generate additional annuity demand at older ages. Overall, individuals under-annuitise by 10.1% during retirement and delay the average age of annuitisation by 3.7 years relative to the objective benchmark. The average welfare loss resulting from biased survival beliefs is equivalent to 2.9% of retirement-age assets. About 31% of this loss is attributable to pessimism about survival, while the remaining 69% reflects misperceptions of how mortality risk increases with age. Counterfactual policy experiments suggest that subsidies for annuity purchases early in retirement financed by taxing later purchases would improve welfare.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了一个动态年金化模型，其中个体持有的主观生存信念可能与其实际死亡风险存在差异。我证明，偏差的生存信念会降低退休时的年金化程度，但在较高年龄段却会产生额外的年金需求。总体而言，个体在退休期间的年金化程度比客观基准低10.1%，并将平均年金化年龄推迟了3.7年。由偏差生存信念导致的平均福利损失相当于退休年龄资产的2.9%。其中约31%的损失归因于对生存的悲观态度，而其余69%则反映了对死亡风险随年龄增长方式的误解。反事实政策实验表明，通过征税后期年金购买来补贴退休早期年金购买的补贴政策将改善福利。

title: Optimal Experimental Design and Estimation when Potential Outcomes are Bounded
title_zh: 当潜在结果有界时的最优实验设计与估计
title_primary: 当潜在结果有界时的最优实验设计与估计
title_secondary: Optimal Experimental Design and Estimation when Potential Outcomes are Bounded
authors: Peter Hull
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: I study the optimal design and analysis of randomized experiments for estimating finite-population average treatment effects when potential outcomes are known to be bounded, as with binary outcomes. Among all assignment mechanisms and a broad class of affine estimators, worst-case mean-squared error (MSE) is minimized by independent random assignment and an unconventional regression of the support-midpoint-centered outcome on the recentered treatment, with no intercept. This contrasts with the usual prescription of balanced complete randomization and difference-in-means estimation: when outcomes are bounded, randomness in the realized treatment share is informative. The worst-case gain over full-sample complete randomization is asymptotically small, but gains can be first-order relative to other designs: complete within-pair randomization and pair-fixed-effect regression have twice the worst-case MSE. I then consider the general problem, allowing for any measurable estimator. Independent random assignment remains optimal, and the generally-nonlinear optimal estimator can meaningfully reduce worst-case MSE.
abstract_zh: 我研究了在潜在结果已知有界（如二元结果）的情况下，估计有限总体平均处理效应的随机实验的最优设计与分析。在所有分配机制和一类广泛的仿射估计量中，最坏情况均方误差（MSE）通过独立随机分配和对以支持中点为中心的结果对重新中心化处理的非常规回归（无截距项）达到最小。这与通常推荐的平衡完全随机化和均值差估计形成对比：当结果有界时，实现处理份额中的随机性具有信息量。相对于全样本完全随机化，最坏情况下的增益渐近地很小，但相对于其他设计，增益可能是一阶的：完全配对随机化和配对固定效应回归的最坏情况MSE是其两倍。随后，我考虑了一般问题，允许任何可测估计量。独立随机分配仍然是最优的，而一般非线性的最优估计量可以显著降低最坏情况MSE。

title: DP12125 Hunting Unicorns? Experimental Evidence on Predatory Pricing Policies
title_zh: 猎捕独角兽？关于掠夺性定价政策的实验证据
title_primary: 猎捕独角兽？关于掠夺性定价政策的实验证据
title_secondary: DP12125 Hunting Unicorns? Experimental Evidence on Predatory Pricing Policies
authors: Aaron Edlin, Catherine Roux, Armin Schmutzler, Christian Thoeni
official: 官方在线 2017-07-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the anti-competitive effects of predatory pricing and the efficacy of three policy responses. In a series of experiments where an incumbent and a potential entrant interact, we compare prices, market structures and welfare. Under a laissez-faire regime, the threat of post-entry price cuts discourages entry, and allows incumbents to charge monopoly prices. Current U.S. policy (Brooke Group) does not help. A policy suggested by Baumol (1979) lowers post-exit prices, while Edlin’s (2002) proposal reduces pre-entry prices and encourages entry. While both policies show outcomes after entry that are less competitive than under Laissez-Faire, they nevertheless increase consumer welfare.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了掠夺性定价的反竞争效应及三种政策应对措施的有效性。在一系列实验中，当在位者与潜在进入者互动时，我们比较了价格、市场结构和福利。在自由放任体制下，进入后价格削减的威胁阻碍了进入，并允许在位者收取垄断价格。当前美国政策（布鲁克集团案）并未起到帮助作用。鲍莫尔（1979）提出的政策降低了退出后的价格，而埃德林（2002）的建议则降低了进入前的价格并鼓励进入。尽管这两种政策在进入后显示出的竞争程度低于自由放任情形，但它们仍提高了消费者福利。

title: Improving Financial Literacy: From Corporate Finance to Personal Finance
title_zh: 提升金融素养：从公司金融到个人金融
title_primary: 提升金融素养：从公司金融到个人金融
title_secondary: Improving Financial Literacy: From Corporate Finance to Personal Finance
authors: Annamaria Lusardi
official: 官方在线 2026-08-16 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This article provides an overview of the literature on financial literacy. It covers the initial measurement that created the Big Three questions and measures of personal finance knowledge featuring 28 questions. It shows that levels of financial literacy are low and have not been improving over time. This is true not only in the United States but also in countries worldwide. These findings matter because financial literacy is conducive to savvy financial behaviors, from holding precautionary savings to planning for retirement to many other financial decisions. Financial education programs have grown exponentially over time, providing important insights into their cost-effectiveness. Personal finance courses have been added to high school and college curricula, and the evidence indicates that they are useful initiatives to improve financial knowledge and downstream behavior.
abstract_zh: 本文对金融素养相关文献进行了综述。文章涵盖了最初构建“三大问题”的测量方法，以及包含28个问题的个人财务知识测量指标。研究表明，金融素养水平普遍较低，且随时间推移并未得到改善。这一现象不仅存在于美国，也见于全球各国。这些发现之所以重要，是因为金融素养有助于促进明智的财务行为，从持有预防性储蓄到规划退休，乃至其他诸多财务决策。金融教育项目数量呈指数级增长，为其成本效益提供了重要见解。个人理财课程已被纳入高中和大学课程体系，证据表明，这些举措在提升金融知识及后续行为方面颇具成效。

title: Extreme heat, supply chain risks and enterprise performance
title_zh: 极端高温、供应链风险与企业绩效
title_primary: 极端高温、供应链风险与企业绩效
title_secondary: Extreme heat, supply chain risks and enterprise performance
authors: Lei Jiang, Rui Wang, Linshuang Yang, Xueying Lyu, Jinxing Guo
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the impact of exposure to high temperatures on the performance of downstream enterprises. By constructing “supplier-customer” pairs during 2010-2019, we explore exogenous variation in temperature and find that high temperatures in suppliers' regions significantly reduce the performance of downstream enterprises. The effects are more pronounced for non-state-owned, smaller, less digitalized, more supply-chain-concentrated, and less monopolistic enterprises. The possible channel is that upstream suppliers pass on the increased costs and risks due to high temperatures to downstream customers, leading to adverse impacts on their performance. Furthermore, downstream enterprises also conduct adaptive behaviors. This study enriches the research on the impact of extreme weather on business activities and provides insights for business managers on how to sustainably adapt to supply chain risks in a warming world.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了高温对下游企业的影响。通过构建2001—2022年间的“供应商—客户”配对，本文利用温度的外生变化发现，供应商所在地区的高温显著降低了客户的绩效。这一效应在非国有企业、规模较小、数字化程度较低、供应链集中度较高以及垄断程度较低的企业中更为明显。可能的传导渠道是，供应商将高温导致的成本增加转嫁给客户，从而对其绩效产生不利影响。本研究丰富了极端天气相关研究，并为在变暖世界中如何应对供应链风险提供了启示。关键词：极端高温 供应链风险 企业绩效 JEL分类：Q54 L25 G30

title: Crop insurance and irrigation behavior: The conditional role of pumping costs
title_zh: 农作物保险与灌溉行为：抽水成本的调节作用
title_primary: 农作物保险与灌溉行为：抽水成本的调节作用
title_secondary: Crop insurance and irrigation behavior: The conditional role of pumping costs
authors: Sungmin Cheu, Molly Sears
official: 官方在线 2026-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Excessive water use for irrigation can accelerate the depletion of water resources, undermining agriculture's resilience to weather‐related shocks. Understanding how farmers make water use decisions is essential for developing effective water management policies. This study investigates the effect of crop insurance participation on water use in the High Plains Aquifer region, using crop‐specific irrigation data and unit pumping costs for groundwater extraction. Building on work by Deryugina & Konar and Sloggy et al., we examine the question of moral hazard in input use, analyzing how water use responses to insurance participation vary with changes in groundwater pumping costs. To address endogeneity between water use and insurance participation, we employ an instrumental variable approach using base premium rates that are determined before farms make production and insurance decisions. We find that insurance participation increases per‐acre water use, but the magnitude of this effect declines as pumping costs rise. At the average pumping costs, a one percentage point increase in insurance participation leads to a 0.4% increase in per‐acre water use. At the 95th percentile of pumping costs, the marginal effect of insurance participation is negligible and close to zero. Our results suggest that water pricing policies should account for indirect effects through insurance participation to avoid the inefficient use of water resources.
abstract_zh: 灌溉用水的过度使用可能加速水资源枯竭，削弱农业应对天气相关冲击的韧性。理解农民如何做出用水决策对于制定有效的水资源管理政策至关重要。本研究利用特定作物的灌溉数据和地下水抽取的单位泵送成本，探讨了高平原含水层区域作物保险参与对用水的影响。在Deryugina & Konar和Sloggy等人研究的基础上，我们考察了投入品使用中的道德风险问题，分析了用水对保险参与的响应如何随地下水抽取成本的变化而变化。为处理用水与保险参与之间的内生性问题，我们采用工具变量方法，利用农场在生产及保险决策前确定的基准保费率作为工具。研究发现，保险参与增加了每亩用水量，但这一效应的规模随泵送成本上升而减小。在平均泵送成本下，保险参与率每增加一个百分点，每亩用水量增加0.4%。在泵送成本的第95百分位数处，保险参与的边际效应可忽略不计，接近于零。我们的结果表明，水价政策应考虑通过保险参与产生的间接效应，以避免水资源利用的低效率。

title: Meritocracy and the Networks It Forged: China's Imperial Examination
title_zh: 功绩制及其缔造的网络：中国的科举制度
title_primary: 功绩制及其缔造的网络：中国的科举制度
title_secondary: Meritocracy and the Networks It Forged: China's Imperial Examination
authors: Ying Bai, Ruixue Jia
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Institutions that claim to reward merit often also serve as engines that drive the formation of important social networks. We examine this dual role in China’s Imperial Examination, one of history’s longest-lived meritocratic systems. We draw on exam performance data for 24,269 individuals across 112 national examinations in the Qing dynasty (1644–1905) and trace who among them rose to become top officials. Strong exam performance increased the likelihood of attaining high office, but advancement also depended on individuals’ ties to powerful examiners. Because performance and ties to powerful examiners were strongly complementary, individuals’ success appeared to rest on merit even as social networks played a role. Following the major political transformations of the 1840s, the importance of examiner ties persisted, although the influential examiners themselves changed. These findings help explain why such systems retain legitimacy even when networks matter greatly.
abstract_zh: 宣称奖励才能的制度，往往同时也充当着构建重要社会网络的引擎。我们通过中国科举制度——历史上寿命最长的精英选拔体系之一——来审视这一双重角色。我们利用清朝（1644-1905年）112次全国考试中24,269人的考试成绩数据，追踪其中谁晋升为高级官员。优异的考试成绩增加了获得高官职位的机会，但晋升同样依赖于个人与有权势考官的联系。由于考试成绩与考官关系紧密互补，个人的成功看似基于才能，即便社会网络也发挥着作用。在19世纪40年代重大政治变革之后，考官关系的重要性持续存在，尽管有影响力的考官本身发生了变化。这些发现有助于解释为何此类制度即便在网络因素影响显著时仍能保持其合法性。

title: Can we make trading less hazardous to investors’ wealth? Evidence from a choice between flat rates or commissions for financial services*
title_zh: 我们能否让交易对投资者财富的危害更小？来自金融服务固定费率与佣金选择的证据
title_primary: 我们能否让交易对投资者财富的危害更小？来自金融服务固定费率与佣金选择的证据
title_secondary: Can we make trading less hazardous to investors’ wealth? Evidence from a choice between flat rates or commissions for financial services*
authors: Steffen Meyer, Charline Uhr
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We exploit a real-world setting at a German brokerage where some investors are forced to choose between two pricing schemes for trading and holding mutual funds: a flat-rate versus commissions (pay-per-use, via front-end loads and annual fees). Advisors provide a tariff recommendation based on clients’ potential cost savings. Most clients follow this recommendation; still, 41% fail to choose the cost-beneficial scheme, and 83% of them exhibit a pay-per-use bias. Biased choices are partly related to the underestimation of trading costs and expectation-based loss aversion. Our results bear implications for designing pricing schemes in the financial industry.
abstract_zh: 我们利用德国一家券商的实际场景，其中部分投资者被迫在两种共同基金交易与持有定价方案之间做出选择：固定费率与按次付费（通过前端费用和年费实现）。顾问基于客户潜在的成本节省提供费率建议。多数客户遵循此建议；然而，仍有41%的客户未能选择成本效益最优的方案，其中83%表现出按次付费偏好偏差。偏差选择部分与对交易成本的低估及基于预期的损失厌恶有关。我们的研究结果对金融行业定价方案的设计具有启示意义。

title: Determining Gender Differences in Education and Labor Market Outcomes
title_zh: 确定教育与劳动力市场结果中的性别差异
title_primary: 确定教育与劳动力市场结果中的性别差异
title_secondary: Determining Gender Differences in Education and Labor Market Outcomes
authors: Carla Varona Cervantes, Russell Cooper
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies gender differences in educational attainment and labor market outcomes. Across 21 OECD countries, though men are paid more than women, the college attainment rates and college premia are (mostly) higher for women. This paper explains these patterns through the quantitative analysis of a dynamic choice model of education and labor market outcomes. Using the estimated model, we decompose the observed gender gaps through a series of counterfactual exercises. One finding is that these gaps are driven mainly by gender differences in the average compensation at non-college jobs. The estimated lower compensation for non-college women generates for them larger college premia and higher incentives to attend college relative to men. A second finding, through the lens of the estimated model, is that observed gender wage gaps for college workers are largely driven by differences in the gender specific distributions across signals of ability rather than wage differences across genders given a signal.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了教育成就与劳动力市场结果中的性别差异。在21个OECD国家中，尽管男性薪酬高于女性，但女性的大学入学率及大学教育溢价（大多）更高。本文通过构建教育与劳动力市场结果的动态选择模型并进行量化分析，解释了上述模式。基于估计模型，我们通过一系列反事实模拟分解了观察到的性别差距。研究发现之一：这些差距主要由非大学职业中男女平均薪酬差异驱动。非大学职业女性薪酬较低，导致其大学教育溢价更高，且相较于男性更倾向于接受高等教育。研究发现之二：通过估计模型的视角，大学劳动者的性别工资差距主要源于不同能力信号在性别分布上的差异，而非给定信号下性别间的工资差异。

title: New Evidence on the Health-Status Gradient from Imperial China
title_zh: 来自中华帝国健康-状况梯度问题的新证据
title_primary: 来自中华帝国健康-状况梯度问题的新证据
title_secondary: New Evidence on the Health-Status Gradient from Imperial China
authors: Wolfgang Keller, Carol H. Shiue, Karen Eggleston
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the relationship between health and social status in China using genealogical data from the 14th to 19th centuries. The data covers broad segments of the population linking husbands, wives, and sons, allowing us to examine whether status was associated with survival not only for adult men but also across households and generations. In a sample centered on the early 1700s, the typical lifespan of married men is 52, but varies widely. High-status men have a 22 percent higher probability of living past 50 than low-status men, resulting in a lifespan advantage of seven years. High status is also associated with significant survival advantages for wives and children. The lifespan premium of the wife of a high-status man over the wife of a commoner exceeds 10 years, and the chance that the son of a high-status man dies before reaching 10 years is less than half that of a low-status man’s son. Up to the 17th century the lifespan advantage is largely confined to those with top status, while the health-status gradient across all status levels emerges during the 18th century. The findings provide new evidence on health-status inequality in a less-studied setting, and suggest that health-status inequality is usefully analyzed from a family and intergenerational perspective.
abstract_zh: 我们利用14至19世纪中国的家谱数据，探讨了健康状况与社会地位之间的关系。这些数据覆盖了广泛的人口群体，将丈夫、妻子和儿子联系起来，使我们能够考察地位是否不仅与成年男性的生存相关，还跨越家庭和世代产生影响。在以18世纪初为中心的样本中，已婚男性的平均寿命为52岁，但差异显著。高地位男性活过50岁的概率比低地位男性高出22%，从而享有七年的寿命优势。高地位还与妻子和子女的显著生存优势相关联。高地位男性的妻子相较于平民妻子的寿命优势超过10年，而高地位男性之子在10岁前死亡的概率不到低地位男性之子的一半。直至17世纪，寿命优势主要局限于最高地位群体，而所有地位层级间的健康-地位梯度则在18世纪显现。这些发现为较少被研究的背景下的健康-地位不平等提供了新证据，并表明从家庭和代际视角分析健康-地位不平等是富有成效的。

title: Fiscal Procyclicality in Commodity Exporting Countries: How Much Does It Pour and Why?
title_zh: 大宗商品出口国的财政顺周期性：程度与成因
title_primary: 大宗商品出口国的财政顺周期性：程度与成因
title_secondary: Fiscal Procyclicality in Commodity Exporting Countries: How Much Does It Pour and Why?
authors: Francisco Arroyo Marioli, Carlos A. Vegh
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: A large literature has documented that fiscal policy is procyclical in emerging markets/developing countries and acyclical/countercyclical in advanced economies. This paper analyzes fiscal procyclicality in commodity-exporting countries. The paper makes two novel contributions. First, based on the “when it rains, it pours” phenomenon (that is, contractionary fiscal policy amplifies the business cycle), the paper shows that, on average, government spending magnifies the business cycle by 21 percent of the initial drop in output following a fall in commodity prices. Second, the paper estimates the welfare costs of fiscal procyclicality at 36 percent of the commodity business cycle. (JEL E32, E62, F14, H50, O19, Q02)
abstract_zh: 大量文献表明，财政政策在新兴市场/发展中国家呈现顺周期性，而在发达经济体中则为非周期性/逆周期性。本文分析了大宗商品出口国的财政顺周期性，并做出两项创新性贡献。首先，基于"祸不单行"现象（即紧缩性财政政策放大经济周期），本文证明：在大宗商品价格下跌后，政府支出平均会使初始产出下降的幅度放大21%。其次，本文估算出财政顺周期性的福利成本相当于大宗商品经济周期的36%。（JEL分类号：E32, E62, F14, H50, O19, Q02）

title: Wishful thinking is risky thinking
title_zh: 一厢情愿是冒险的思维
title_primary: 一厢情愿是冒险的思维
title_secondary: Wishful thinking is risky thinking
authors: Jarrod Burgh, Emerson Melo
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper develops a tractable model of wishful thinking that captures both the benefits and costs of optimistic biased beliefs and the behaviors they induce. Building on Bratcha and Brown (2012) and Caplin and Leahy (2019), we propose a two-stage framework in which a decision maker selects actions and belief structures under uncertainty, balancing subjective utility against the cost of departing from prior beliefs. The cost is formalized using a $$\phi $$ ϕ -divergence–based belief distortion function, encompassing measures such as Kullback–Leibler, reverse Kullback-Leibler, and Pearson $$\chi ^2$$ χ 2 distances. Our contributions are threefold: (i) we characterize optimal beliefs, showing they twist prior probabilities toward high-utility states across a broad class of divergences; (ii) we link WT behavior to risk-seeking actions via convex risk measures; and (iii) we introduce cognitive censoring and cognitive emergence, capturing extreme beliefs. Methodologically, the model provides new insights into how optimistic beliefs reshape decision-making, extending the theoretical foundations of WT and opening avenues for future research.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个易于处理的一厢情愿思维模型，该模型既捕捉了乐观偏差信念的收益与成本，也刻画了由此引发的行为。基于Bratcha和Brown（2012）以及Caplin和Leahy（2019）的研究，我们提出了一个两阶段框架：决策者在不确定性下选择行动与信念结构，在主观效用与偏离先验信念的成本之间进行权衡。该成本通过基于$$\phi $$-散度的信念扭曲函数形式化，涵盖Kullback-Leibler散度、逆Kullback-Leibler散度以及Pearson $$\chi ^2$$距离等度量。我们的贡献有三方面：（i）刻画了最优信念，表明在广泛的散度类别中，最优信念会将先验概率向高效用状态扭曲；（ii）通过凸风险度量将一厢情愿行为与风险寻求行动联系起来；（iii）引入认知审查与认知涌现概念，以捕捉极端信念。在方法论上，该模型为乐观信念如何重塑决策提供了新见解，拓展了一厢情愿思维的理论基础，并为未来研究开辟了方向。

title: Meritocracy in the face of group inequality
title_zh: 群体不平等面前的精英统治
title_primary: 群体不平等面前的精英统治
title_secondary: Meritocracy in the face of group inequality
authors: Rajiv Sethi, Rohini Somanathan
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract Meritocratic systems are commonly understood as those that assign tasks to individuals who can best perform them. But future performance is not known prior to assignment, and must be inferred from other traits. We consider a model in which performance depends on two attributes—ability and training—where ability is endowed and unobserved, and training is acquired and observed. The potential to acquire training depends on ability and resource access, so ability affects performance through two channels: indirectly through training, and directly through the performance function. The population consists of two groups, each with the same ability distribution, but with differential access to resources. We show that performance‐maximizing allocations are not necessarily group‐blind or monotonic in training, and can involve greater representation of groups with lower resource access than would arise if the only criteria for selection were past performance. If policies are constrained to be monotonic due to the possibility of strategic applicant behaviour, then these representation effects can be mitigated or amplified, depending on the fraction of the population that is selected.
abstract_zh: 摘要 精英体制通常被理解为将任务分配给最能胜任者的制度。但未来表现无法在分配前预知，必须通过其他特征推断。我们构建了一个模型，其中表现取决于两种属性——能力与训练——能力是先天赋予且不可观测的，训练是后天获得且可观测的。获得训练的潜力取决于能力与资源获取渠道，因此能力通过两条渠道影响表现：间接通过训练，直接通过表现函数。人口由两个群体组成，每个群体具有相同的能力分布，但资源获取渠道存在差异。研究表明，表现最大化分配未必是群体盲视的或关于训练单调的，且可能使资源获取较少的群体获得比仅以过往表现为唯一选拔标准时更高的代表性。若因策略性申请者行为的存在而需对政策施加单调性约束，则这些代表性效应可能被削弱或放大，具体取决于被选拔人口的比例。

title: Evaluating macroeconomic outcomes under asymmetries: Expectations matter
title_zh: 评估非对称性下的宏观经济结果：预期至关重要
title_primary: 评估非对称性下的宏观经济结果：预期至关重要
title_secondary: Evaluating macroeconomic outcomes under asymmetries: Expectations matter
authors: Brent Bundick, Isabel Cairó, Nicolas Petrosky-Nadeau
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-23 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Asymmetries play an important role in many macroeconomic models. We show that assumptions on household and firm expectations play a key role in determining the effects of these asymmetries on macroeconomic outcomes. If households and firms have perfect foresight and hence do not account for the possibility of future shocks, then the implied longer-run averages and distributions can differ significantly from their rational expectations counterparts. We first derive this result analytically in a standard New Keynesian environment under either an asymmetric monetary policy rule or a nonlinear Phillips curve before numerically examining some of the key nonlinearities featured in the recent literature.
abstract_zh: 不对称性在许多宏观经济模型中扮演着重要角色。我们证明，家庭和企业预期的假设在决定这些不对称性对宏观经济结果的影响方面起着关键作用。如果家庭和企业拥有完美预见能力，因此不考虑未来冲击的可能性，那么由此隐含的长期平均值和分布可能与理性预期下的对应值存在显著差异。我们首先在标准新凯恩斯主义环境中，在非对称货币政策规则或非线性菲利普斯曲线下，从分析上推导出这一结果，随后数值考察了近期文献中强调的一些关键非线性特征。

title: Is the iPhone Birth Control? Causal Evidence from AT&T’s 2007–2011 Carrier Monopoly
title_zh: iPhone是避孕工具吗？来自AT&T 2007–2011年运营商垄断的因果证据
title_primary: iPhone是避孕工具吗？来自AT&T 2007–2011年运营商垄断的因果证据
title_secondary: Is the iPhone Birth Control? Causal Evidence from AT&T’s 2007–2011 Carrier Monopoly
authors: Myers, Caitlin, Hooper, Ezekiel, Myers, Caitlin Knowles
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: The U.S. general fertility rate has fallen by 22% since 2007, a sustained decline not readily explained by economic conditions, contraceptive use, housing or childcare costs, or other commonly cited factors. We assess the potential role of a different shock: the diffusion of the smartphone. The U.S. rollout of the iPhone, the first modern smartphone, provides a natural experiment: from June 2007 through February 2011, the device was sold only on AT&T, allowing us to identify its effect from variation in AT&T’s mobile broadband coverage. Entropy-balanced Poisson and synthetic difference-in-differences event studies imply that access to the iPhone reduced births by 4.5–8.0% at ages 15–19 and 3.2–6.6% at ages 20–24, with statistically significant but smaller declines among older cohorts. Placebo analyses applied to Verizon and Sprint’s pre-2011 coverage footprint are null. Taken together, these cohort effects imply that the diffusion of the iPhone deepened the decline in births among women under 30 while suppressing the rise in births among older women. Overall, the diffusion of the iPhone explains 33–52% of the decline in the general fertility rate among women aged 15–44. National-survey evidence on time use and sexual behavior is consistent with the iPhone reducing in-person interactions, increasing pornography use, and reducing sexual frequency.
abstract_zh: 自2007年以来，美国总和生育率下降了22%，这一持续下降趋势难以用经济状况、避孕措施使用、住房或育儿成本等常见因素解释。我们评估了另一种冲击的潜在作用：智能手机的普及。美国首款现代智能手机iPhone的推广提供了一个自然实验：从2007年6月至2011年2月，该设备仅由AT&T独家销售，这使我们能够通过AT&T移动宽带覆盖范围的差异识别其影响。基于熵平衡泊松模型和合成双重差分事件研究的结果表明，iPhone的接入使15-19岁年龄段生育率下降4.5%-8.0%，20-24岁年龄段下降3.2%-6.6%，而较高年龄段虽呈现统计显著但降幅较小。针对Verizon和Sprint在2011年前覆盖范围的安慰剂分析未发现显著效应。综合来看，这些队列效应表明iPhone的普及加剧了30岁以下女性生育率的下降，同时抑制了高龄女性生育率的上升。总体而言，iPhone的普及解释了15-44岁女性总和生育率下降幅度的33%-52%。基于全国调查的时间使用与性行为证据显示，iPhone减少了面对面互动，增加了色情内容使用，并降低了性行为频率。

title: Worker Heterogeneity and the Effect of Noncompetes on Firm Performance
title_zh: 工人异质性与竞业限制对企业绩效的影响
title_primary: 工人异质性与竞业限制对企业绩效的影响
title_secondary: Worker Heterogeneity and the Effect of Noncompetes on Firm Performance
authors: Zhaozhao He, Modupe Babajide Wintoki
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using staggered state‐level changes in noncompete enforceability, we document that reduced enforcement increases profitability, valuation, productivity, and plant‐level growth in knowledge‐worker‐intensive firms relative to other firms. Critically, these gains are concentrated among the most productive knowledge‐worker firms, consistent with an assortative matching mechanism in which top firms attract the most productive workers when noncompetes no longer bind. Using inventor‐level data, we find direct evidence of this sorting: more productive inventors migrate toward more productive firms following reductions in enforceability. Consequently, performance dispersion widens across knowledge‐worker‐intensive industries, as the most productive firms pull further ahead of their less productive peers.
abstract_zh: 利用各州对竞业限制可执行性的交错调整，我们研究发现：相较于其他企业，降低竞业限制执行力度会提升知识密集型企业的盈利能力、估值、生产率及工厂层面的增长。关键的是，这些收益集中在最具生产力的知识密集型企业中，这与"分类匹配机制"的推论一致——当竞业限制不再具有约束力时，顶尖企业能够吸引最具生产力的劳动者。基于发明者层面的数据，我们发现了这种分类效应的直接证据：在竞业限制执行力度降低后，更具生产力的发明者会向更具生产力的企业迁移。由此，知识密集型行业内的绩效差距持续扩大，最具生产力的企业进一步拉开与低效同行的差距。

title: Work orientations and turnover
title_zh: 工作导向与离职倾向
title_primary: 工作导向与离职倾向
title_secondary: Work orientations and turnover
authors: Milena Nikolova, Juliette de Wit
official: 官方在线 2026-06-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Voluntary turnover imposes substantial costs on organizations, yet we know little about whether workers’ fundamental orientations toward work shape their mobility decisions. In this paper, we distinguish between job, career, and calling orientations, defined as the long-term beliefs about the role of work in one’s life. Using original survey data from the Dutch LISS panel, we show that work orientations are strong predictors of quit intentions and on-the-job search, even after controlling for socio-demographic characteristics, personality traits, job characteristics, and job satisfaction. Career-oriented individuals exhibit significantly higher quit intentions and search activity, particularly when perceived promotion opportunities are limited. Calling-oriented individuals report substantially lower quit intentions and on-the-job search. By contrast, having a job orientation is not systematically associated with turnover-related outcomes. The associations between work orientations and actual job quits one and two years later are weaker, suggesting that work orientations primarily shape turnover intentions and preparatory search behavior, while actual working conditions more strongly influence mobility. Overall, our findings identify work orientations as a novel and quantitatively important determinant of turnover-related behavior and highlight the role of workers’ underlying motivations in shaping mobility beyond standard economic predictors.
abstract_zh: 自愿离职给组织带来巨大成本，然而我们对工作者对工作的基本取向是否影响其流动决策知之甚少。本文区分了工作取向、职业取向和使命取向，这些取向被定义为关于工作在生活中角色的长期信念。利用荷兰LISS面板的原始调查数据，我们发现即使在控制社会人口特征、人格特质、工作特征和工作满意度后，工作取向仍是离职意向和在职求职的强预测因子。职业取向个体表现出显著更高的离职意向和求职活动，尤其在感知晋升机会有限时。使命取向个体报告的离职意向和在职求职显著较低。相比之下，工作取向与离职相关结果并无系统性关联。工作取向与一年及两年后实际离职的关联较弱，表明工作取向主要塑造离职意向和预备性求职行为，而实际工作条件对流动性的影响更强。总体而言，我们的研究将工作取向识别为离职相关行为的新颖且数量上重要的决定因素，并强调工作者潜在动机在标准经济预测因子之外对流动性塑造的作用。

title: JUE insight: City size, monopsony, and the employment effects of minimum wages
title_zh: JUE洞察：城市规模、买方垄断与最低工资的就业效应
title_primary: JUE洞察：城市规模、买方垄断与最低工资的就业效应
title_secondary: JUE insight: City size, monopsony, and the employment effects of minimum wages
authors: Priyaranjan Jha, Jyotsana Kala, David Neumark, Antonio Rodriguez-Lopez
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We assess how minimum wage effects on restaurant employment in the U.S. vary with market size and monopsony power. Using city-level data, we construct monopsony proxies based on labor flows and concentration. Minimum wages bind less in larger cities, consistent with the urban wage premium, and omitting this relationship overstates how labor market power reduces adverse employment effects of minimum wages. Nonetheless, accounting for size, lower labor market fluidity is linked to weaker employment effects, consistent with search models. By contrast, concentration-based proxies are less informative in this setting: employer-density measures move opposite to theory, while HHI exhibits insufficient variation.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了美国最低工资对餐饮业就业的影响如何随市场规模和买方垄断力量而变化。利用城市层面的数据，我们基于劳动力流动和集中度构建了买方垄断代理指标。最低工资在大城市中的约束力较弱，这与城市工资溢价一致，而忽略这一关系会高估劳动力市场力量对最低工资不利就业效应的缓解作用。尽管如此，在考虑规模因素后，较低的劳动力市场流动性仍与较弱的就业效应相关联，这与搜寻模型相符。相比之下，基于集中度的代理指标在此情境中信息量有限：雇主密度指标的变化方向与理论相反，而赫芬达尔指数则表现出不足的变异性。

title: Are patents with female inventors under-cited? Evidence from text estimation
title_zh: 女性发明人的专利是否被低估引用？基于文本估计的证据
title_primary: 女性发明人的专利是否被低估引用？基于文本估计的证据
title_secondary: Are patents with female inventors under-cited? Evidence from text estimation
authors: Yael V. Hochberg, Ali Kakhbod, Peiyao Li, Kunal Sachdeva
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Utilizing leading machine learning techniques to analyze the textual content and quality of patents, we demonstrate that patents with female lead inventors are under-cited relative to what would be expected had the lead inventor been male. Male inventors are the greatest contributors to the undercitation of patents with female inventors, followed by female inventors and male examiners, while female patent examiners appear to be even-handed. Using market reactions to patents suggests no average difference in market value by the inventor’s gender. The results have potential implications for research conclusions that rely on citation-based assessments of patent quality.
abstract_zh: 利用前沿机器学习技术分析专利的文本内容与质量，我们证明，若主要发明人为女性，其专利被引用的频率低于预期——即相较于主要发明人为男性时的情况。男性发明人是导致女性发明人专利被低估引用的最大贡献者，其次是女性发明人和男性审查员，而女性专利审查员则显得较为公正。基于市场对专利的反应，发明人性别在平均市场价值上并无差异。这些发现对依赖基于引用的专利质量评估的研究结论具有潜在影响。

title: Pay for(eign) performance: CEO pay incentives for foreign tax savings
title_zh: 为（外国）绩效付费：CEO薪酬激励与外国税收节省
title_primary: 为（外国）绩效付费：CEO薪酬激励与外国税收节省
title_secondary: Pay for(eign) performance: CEO pay incentives for foreign tax savings
authors: Kathleen Boylen, Fabio B. Gaertner, Melissa A. Martin
official: 官方在线 2026-05-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper investigates the relation between executive compensation and corporate tax policies, with a focus on the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 (TCJA). Using a pay-performance sensitivity framework, we analyze the differing compensation rewards associated with domestic and foreign pre-tax incomes. Our findings reveal that, before the TCJA, executives received significantly higher rewards for foreign income, encouraging them to shift income abroad. The TCJA reduced this disparity, bringing rewards for domestic and foreign income into closer alignment. A cross-sectional analysis shows that firms assessing CEO performance based on after-tax income exhibit greater sensitivity to changes in tax policy, establishing the presence of a tax mechanism. Additional tests eliminate alternative nontax explanations related to protectionist trade policies and changes in foreign market growth opportunities. These results highlight the significant impact of executive incentives on corporate tax behavior and the effectiveness of tax policy reforms.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了高管薪酬与企业税收政策之间的关系，特别聚焦于2017年的《减税与就业法案》（TCJA）。通过运用薪酬-绩效敏感性框架，我们分析了国内外税前收入所对应的不同薪酬奖励。研究发现，在TCJA实施前，高管因外国收入获得的奖励显著更高，这鼓励他们将收入转移至海外。TCJA缩小了这一差距，使国内外收入的奖励趋于一致。截面分析显示，基于税后收入评估CEO绩效的企业，对税收政策变化更为敏感，从而证实了税收机制的存在。额外的检验排除了与保护主义贸易政策及外国市场增长机会变化相关的非税收替代解释。这些结果凸显了高管激励对企业税收行为的重大影响，以及税收政策改革的有效性。

title: Following the money: an econometric investigation into health valuations
title_zh: 追踪资金流向：健康价值评估的计量经济学研究
title_primary: 追踪资金流向：健康价值评估的计量经济学研究
title_secondary: Following the money: an econometric investigation into health valuations
authors: Tinna Laufey Ásgeirsdóttir, Viktor Andri Kárason
official: 官方在线 2026-05-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In 2018, two compensating‐income variation studies, based on Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia, reported sharply different monetary health values: A$42,000–A$67,000 for a full quality‐adjusted life year (QALY) gain versus A$162,000 for a 0.10 QALY loss (implying A$1.6 million per QALY under linear scaling). We embark on econometric detective work to identify the sources of these discrepancies, carefully aligning samples, cross‐examining methodologies, and uncovering methodological differences that drive the divergent results. Gain–loss framing is the largest margin (consistent with willingness‐to‐accept/willingness‐to‐pay evidence), while estimator choice (instrumental variables versus reduced form) and income equivalization further magnify differences, jointly resulting in the order‐of‐magnitude gaps with implications beyond health.
abstract_zh: 2018年，两项基于澳大利亚家庭、收入与劳动动态调查的补偿性收入变化研究，报告了截然不同的货币化健康价值：完全质量调整生命年（QALY）增益为42,000–67,000澳元，而0.10 QALY损失则为162,000澳元（在线性缩放下相当于每QALY 160万澳元）。我们展开计量经济学侦探工作，以识别这些差异的来源，仔细对齐样本、交叉检验方法论，并揭示导致结果分歧的方法论差异。得失框架是最大的差异来源（与意愿接受/意愿支付证据一致），而估计量选择（工具变量与简化形式）及收入等值化进一步放大了差异，共同导致了数量级上的差距，其影响超越了健康领域。

title: Eliciting Multiple Prior Beliefs
title_zh: 引出多重先验信念
title_primary: 引出多重先验信念
title_secondary: Eliciting Multiple Prior Beliefs
authors: Mohammed Abdellaoui, Philippe Colo, Brian Hill
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Despite the increasing importance of multiple priors in various domains of economics, choice-based incentive-compatible multiple-prior elicitation remains an open problem. This paper develops a solution, comprising a preference-based identification of a subject’s probability interval for an event, and a method for eliciting it. The method applies under weak decision-theoretic assumptions, with no need for probabilistic sophistication. To demonstrate its feasibility, we implement it in three incentivized experiments on artificial and natural sources of uncertainty. Intervals elicited by our method are sensitive to the direction and amount of information and are typically consistent with “objective” probabilities where available. We find a predominance of non-degenerate probability intervals, with intervals being wider when there is less information or predictability. The probability intervals elicited with our method are similar to those stated by subjects on aggregate, suggesting that the method can provide behavioural foundations for the use of stated probability-interval techniques in the field.
abstract_zh: 尽管多重先验在经济学各领域的重要性日益凸显，基于选择的激励相容多重先验启发仍是一个未解难题。本文提出一套解决方案，包含基于偏好的个体事件概率区间识别方法及其启发技术。该方法在弱决策理论假设下适用，无需概率精炼性假设。为验证可行性，我们针对人工与自然不确定性来源开展三项激励实验。实验表明：该方法启发的概率区间对信息方向与信息量敏感，且在存在客观概率时通常与之吻合。我们发现非退化概率区间占主导地位，当信息量较少或可预测性较低时区间宽度更大。该方法启发的概率区间与受试者整体陈述的区间相似，表明该技术可为实地研究中陈述概率区间方法提供行为基础。

title: The Drivers and Implications of Retail Margin Trading
title_zh: 零售保证金交易的驱动因素及其影响
title_primary: 零售保证金交易的驱动因素及其影响
title_secondary: The Drivers and Implications of Retail Margin Trading
authors: JIANGZE BIAN, ZHI DA, ZHIGUO HE, DONG LOU, KELLY SHUE 等
official: 官方在线 2026-05-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using granular data covering both regulated (brokerage‐financed) and unregulated (shadow‐financed) margin accounts in China, we provide novel evidence on retail investors' margin trading behavior and its price implications. We first show that retail investors' decisions to lever up in stock trading despite the hefty borrowing cost is related to their lottery preferences. We then show that margin borrowing affects investors' trading behavior—investors are more likely to liquidate their holdings as they approach margin calls. Finally, we show that margin‐induced trading aggregates to affect asset prices and contributes to shock spillovers across stocks (e.g., from lottery stocks to nonlottery stocks).
abstract_zh: 利用涵盖中国受监管（券商融资）和未受监管（影子融资）保证金账户的颗粒化数据，我们提供了关于散户投资者保证金交易行为及其价格影响的新证据。首先，我们证明散户投资者在股票交易中尽管面临高昂的借贷成本仍选择加杠杆的行为，与其博彩偏好相关。其次，我们揭示保证金借贷会影响投资者的交易行为——当投资者接近追加保证金通知时，更倾向于抛售持仓。最后，我们证明由保证金驱动的交易会聚合影响资产价格，并加剧股票间的冲击溢出效应（例如，从博彩类股票向非博彩类股票传导）。

title: Past is prologue: Inference from the cross section of returns around an event
title_zh: 过去即是序幕：事件前后横截面收益的推断
title_primary: 过去即是序幕：事件前后横截面收益的推断
title_secondary: Past is prologue: Inference from the cross section of returns around an event
authors: Jonathan B. Cohn, Travis L. Johnson, Zack Liu, Malcolm I. Wardlaw
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-03-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Confounding events can cause false positives when testing the relationship between short-term returns around a quasi-experimental event and firm characteristics. We show that this risk is severe in practice — return-characteristic relationships are often statistically significant at the 1% level on over 30% of all trading days. Benchmarking a relationship against the distribution of the same relationship on pre-event days is effective at addressing the problem. We introduce a novel GLS variation of this approach that achieves large gains in statistical power relative to OLS and provide Stata and Python modules that implement both procedures.
abstract_zh: 混淆事件在检验准实验事件前后短期收益与企业特征之间的关系时，可能导致假阳性结果。我们表明，这一风险在实践中十分严重——在超过30%的所有交易日中，收益与特征之间的关系通常在1%显著性水平上具有统计显著性。将某一关系与事件前日期的同一关系分布进行基准比较，能有效解决此问题。我们引入了一种新颖的GLS变体方法，相较于OLS，在统计功效上实现了大幅提升，并提供Stata和Python模块以实施这两种程序。

title: A Bayesian approach to modeling economic growth: Variable selection and cross-sectional dependence
title_zh: 贝叶斯方法在经济建模中的应用：变量选择与截面依赖
title_primary: 贝叶斯方法在经济建模中的应用：变量选择与截面依赖
title_secondary: A Bayesian approach to modeling economic growth: Variable selection and cross-sectional dependence
authors: Guohua Feng, Chuan Wang, Subal C. Kumbhakar
official: 官方在线 2025-07-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper introduces a Bayesian framework designed to address two critical econometric challenges in empirical growth studies: variable selection and cross-sectional dependence. We first propose a growth regression model that incorporates cross-sectional dependence through a multi-factor structure and accounts for variable selection with sparse coefficients. We then introduce a new Bayesian Adaptive LASSO estimator specifically designed for this model, capable of performing variable selection while simultaneously addressing cross-sectional dependence. To validate this framework, we conduct a Monte Carlo study, demonstrating that our Adaptive Bayesian LASSO growth regression model with a factor structure consistently outperforms three benchmark models across all evaluation metrics. Furthermore, we apply our model to a dataset encompassing 55 candidate variables across 71 countries from 1961 to 2019. Our empirical comparison confirms the superiority of our model over the benchmark models. Additionally, our model identifies five global factors and 16 key growth determinants, with robustness checks using Principal Component Analysis and instrumental variables confirming the reliability of our findings.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种贝叶斯框架，旨在解决实证增长研究中两个关键计量经济学挑战：变量选择与横截面依赖性。我们首先构建了一个增长回归模型，该模型通过多因子结构纳入横截面依赖性，并利用稀疏系数处理变量选择问题。随后，我们引入了一种专为此模型设计的新型贝叶斯自适应LASSO估计器，该估计器能够在处理横截面依赖性的同时执行变量选择。为验证此框架，我们进行了蒙特卡洛研究，结果表明，带有因子结构的自适应贝叶斯LASSO增长回归模型在所有评估指标上均持续优于三个基准模型。此外，我们将该模型应用于涵盖1961年至2019年间71个国家55个候选变量的数据集。实证比较进一步证实了我们的模型相对于基准模型的优越性。同时，我们的模型识别出五个全球因子和16个关键增长决定因素，并通过主成分分析和工具变量的稳健性检验确认了研究结果的可靠性。
